exposure: Service coverage (nine prevention indicators and five treatment indicators)
Macroeconomic and health systems characteristics (e.g., primary health-care institutions)
cohort: The study included 901,182 individuals (aged 15 years and older, or children whose adult family members answered for them) from sampled households across all 31 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities in mainland China.
finding: The overall UHC in China increased from 44.0% in 2003 to 79.8% in 2018 and is predicted to meet the 80% global target by 2030, but the progress has steadily slowed down nationally, with prevention indicators performing poorly compared to treatment indicators.
cross-section timing: Surveys conducted in September-October 2003, June-July 2008, August-October 2013, and September 2018.
